podcast.title: Ticketing Practices
podcast.body: Jam bands like The Grateful Dead and The String Cheese Incident are noted for their unique approach to ticketing, often developing their own mail order systems to maintain control over ticket distribution directly to their dedicated fanbases. "The other group was another Jam band, Denver's string cheese incident."
